races.name: Tour de l'Ain
races.description: A transitional stage through the Ain department that tackles the Col de Portes twice on a finishing circuit around Lagnieu, likely thinning the bunch ahead of the mountainous stage 3 finale in the Jura.

broadcasts.notes: Part of HBO Max subscription; also shown on Eurosport 1 linear channel.

broadcasts.platform: France 3 / ICI Alpes, ICI Rhône-Alpes, ICI Auvergne
broadcasts.notes: Free-to-air regional France Télévisions coverage, commentated by Bernard Hinault; also streamed on france3-regions.franceinfo.fr.

broadcasts.platform: Eurosport / HBO Max (Discovery+ in some markets)
broadcasts.notes: Availability via Discovery+ or HBO Max depends on country.
$39.99/month or annual plan; FloBikes carries the full road cycling calendar.

data_confidence.notes: Finish time is a model-based estimate; no live results existed at research time. UK-specific broadcaster for this race was not separately confirmed.

races.name: PostNord Tour of Denmark
races.description: The 2026 Danmark Rundt opens with a circuit stage around Aalborg, including three late climbs of Mølleparken and a hill sprint near Øster Hornum that could crack the bunch before a likely reduced sprint finish.

broadcasts.notes: Daily coverage starts 15:45 local (13:30 on Sundays, when the race starts earlier).
Eurosport 1 linear broadcast is confirmed for stages on Thursday and Friday; other days stream via Discovery+/HBO Max app depending on country.
Sources disagree: Domestique lists TNT Sports/HBO Max coverage, while CyclingUpToDate reports no TNT Sports broadcast for this race. Confirm on the day.

data_confidence.notes: UK broadcaster conflicts between sources (see note above). Finish time is a model-based estimate based on distance and profile.

issues: No women's UCI-ranked races (WorldTour, ProSeries, or 1.1/2.1 and above) were found scheduled for 2026-07-29; the calendar appears to be a men's-only day at this level, sitting in the post-Tour de France lull.
Finish times for both races are model-based estimates (average speed vs. distance/profile), since neither stage had finished at research time.
UK broadcast coverage for the PostNord Tour of Denmark is disputed between two cycling media sources (Domestique vs. CyclingUpToDate) — flagged in that race's broadcast notes rather than resolved.

Broadcast start times for Tour de l'Ain vary slightly (14:30 vs 14:45 CEST) across French sources reporting on the same Eurosport/HBO Max and France 3 windows; 14:30 and 14:45 were used respectively for the pan-European and French regional feeds.

Direct deep-link stream URLs behind subscription logins (HBO Max, Eurosport) could not be verified beyond the platform homepage, since these require authentication; platform homepages were used instead of unreachable account-specific URLs.
